understanding.goal_understanding: The goal was to solve each level by positioning the selectable piece(s) so that every goal tile marked with a `+` is occupied by a selectable piece at the same time, within the limited step budget, and ultimately clear all levels to win the full run.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Each action consumed one step. Clicking on a grid coordinate attempted to move the currently-selected piece to that square (often by sliding in a straight line along the grid until the target, if the path/target was valid); if the target was blocked by walls/obstacles or otherwise unreachable/illegal, the piece did not move. Selecting among multiple pieces was done by clicking on the piece you want active (or its location), after which subsequent clicks/moves applied to that selected piece.

understanding.goal_understanding: The goal was to solve each level by positioning the selectable piece(s) so that every goal tile marked with a `+` is occupied by a selectable piece at the same time, within the limited step budget, and ultimately clear all levels to win the full run.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Each action consumed one step. Clicking on a grid coordinate attempted to move the currently-selected piece to that square (often by sliding in a straight line along the grid until the target, if the path/target was valid); if the target was blocked by walls/obstacles or otherwise unreachable/illegal, the piece did not move. Selecting among multiple pieces was done by clicking on the piece you want active (or its location), after which subsequent clicks/moves applied to that selected piece.
